scientific_role: record-lineage fragment integrity and overhead pilot

identity_contract: every output row retains one non-null source key
the source key is unique across output rows
the source key is not masked
raw source keys are hashed and never stored in the lineage artifact

unsupported_fail_closed: missing, NULL, duplicate, or masked identity keys
integrity_gates: direct and record variants produce identical result digests
every record edge is recomputed from actual output rows
edge count equals output row count
the run uses a clean committed Git snapshot
decision_policy: This pilot cannot authorize publication performance claims.
A PASS admits a separately frozen formal record-lineage experiment.
A FAIL retains the narrow fragment and triggers diagnosis before any scale increase.
No Join or Aggregate result may be relabeled as covered by this protocol.
